description: GuardDuty IAM finding indicating active credential compromise or unauthorized use (Tor/malicious-IP callers, anomalous behavior, credential exfiltration, brute-forced console logins).
playbook: GuardDuty has flagged this IAM identity's credentials as actively compromised. Confirm the finding in the GuardDuty console, then disable the flagged access key (or the whole user, if console-session-based). Rotate any other credentials the actor may have touched and review CloudTrail for actions taken under this identity in the finding window.
_sync_note: If this rule's activity_name pattern changes, update 028_guardduty_catchall.json's matching not_matches condition -- see docs/detection-rules.md#keeping-this-in-sync.
